BUSINESS INTENT: Comics Explore Core Metrics
Intent ID: intent_comics_explore_overview
Description: Core cross-cutting measures and calculations defined at the root of explore 'comics_explore' (file 3_explores/comics_explore.malloy).
Required Explore: comics_explore
Relevant Joined Entities: calendar
File: 3_explores/comics_explore.malloy | Dialect: duckdb | Primary Key: Comic_key

Key Measures & Metrics:
  * `Comic_Count` (number): Total number of comics in the catalogue.
  * `Total_Transcript_Words` (number): Total number of transcript words across the selected comics.
  * `Average_Transcript_Words` (number): Average number of transcript words per comic.
  * `Average_Title_Words` (number): Average number of words in a comic title.
  * `Average_Tooltip_Words` (number): Average number of words in a comic tooltip.
  * `Comics_With_News` (number): Number of comics that include news text.
  * `Comics_With_Links` (number): Number of comics that include an outbound link.
  * `calendar.Day_Count` (number): Number of calendar days in the selected period.

Key Dimensions:
  * `Comic_key` (string): Surrogate key for the comic, derived from the XKCD comic number.
  * `Calendar_key` (date): Publication date used to join the comic to the calendar dimension.
  * `Comic_number` (string): XKCD comic number as published by the API.
  * `Link` (string): Optional URL the comic links to.
  * `News` (string): Optional news or announcement text attached to the comic.
  * `Safe_title` (string): URL-safe title of the comic.
  * `Title` (string): Display title of the comic.
  * `Transcript` (string): Transcript text of the comic when available.
  * `Extra_parts` (string): Extra parts required by interactive comics.
  * `Tooltip_text` (string): Alt text shown when hovering over the comic.
  * `Image_url` (string): URL of the comic image.
  * `News_count` (number): 1 when the comic has news text, otherwise 0.
  * `Link_count` (number): 1 when the comic has a link, otherwise 0.
  * `Extra_parts_count` (number): 1 when the comic has extra parts, otherwise 0.
  * `Transcript_characters` (number): Number of characters in the transcript.

# Zero-Shot Executable Malloy Reference Pattern:
run: comics_explore -> {
  group_by: Month
  aggregate:
    Comic_Count
    Total_Transcript_Words
    Average_Transcript_Words
    Average_Title_Words
    Average_Tooltip_Words
    Comics_With_News
    Comics_With_Links
    calendar.Day_Count
}
